frame.note: x=0 is the team's own alliance wall, +x toward the opponent wall; y follows WPILib after the symmetry transform; *_norm values are 0..1 of the full field

legend: Moving = smoothed speed >= 0.5 m/s (a parked robot's smoothed speed reads below this ~98% of the time). Moving fraction = moving ÷ (moving + stationary) seconds, pooled over counted matches; seconds per match are raw (they shrink with low coverage, the fraction does not). Rank score = average speed over all tracked time = moving fraction × mean speed while moving: faster when moving and less time stopped both raise it. Top speed = median over matches of the highest speed held for 1.5 s. Positions are median-smoothed over 1 s; speed = smoothed displacement across a centred 1 s window ÷ its duration, never across a tracking gap > 0.6 s or a tracker-slot change. Runs of bit-identical positions longer than 0.5 s are stalled tracking: if the robot is still within 0.3 m of that spot when tracking resumes it sat still (counted as stationary), otherwise those seconds are unknown and excluded. A match counts only with >= 30 s of valid tracking; fewer than 2 counted matches = low data.
